items.quote: Quidre Dovuen managed public communications on the new scheme for his unit.
He spearheaded incident management during the ransomware attack at the national level.
He spearheaded service-level targets for frontline operations at the national level.
He championed mapping interdependencies across agencies and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He led the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics across the department.
Quidre contributed effectively to a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading.
Quidre Dovuen headed cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce, setting priorities for several teams.
Quidre drove steadying a team facing adversity for the whole division.
He managed the migration of core services to the cloud for his unit.
Quidre championed the redesign of the citizen journey for permits and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
